score_method: Heuristic sum of finding severity points, capped at 100; not CVSS.

findings.title: Enable secret not found
findings.evidence: No enable secret command was found in global configuration.
findings.recommendation: Configure an approved strong enable secret if privileged EXEC access uses local credentials.

findings.title: No local username using secret syntax detected
findings.evidence: No local username ... secret command was found.
findings.recommendation: Verify the AAA design; configure protected local credentials if local authentication is required.

findings.title: SSH version 2 not explicitly configured
findings.evidence: ip ssh version 2 was not found.
findings.recommendation: If supported, explicitly require SSH version 2 and validate client compatibility.

findings.title: VTY transport policy not explicit
findings.evidence: No transport input command found in line vty 0 4.
findings.recommendation: Review platform defaults and explicitly restrict management transports.

findings.title: VTY idle timeout not detected
findings.evidence: No exec-timeout command found in line vty 0 4.
findings.recommendation: Set an idle timeout appropriate to the security policy.

findings.title: No IPv4 ACL definitions detected
findings.evidence: No numbered or named IPv4 ACL definition was found.
findings.recommendation: If filtering is part of the design, verify ACLs are defined and applied in the correct direction; absence may be intentional.
findings.remediation_example: ! Define ACLs only from the approved network policy

findings.title: Routed interface has no interface ACL detected
findings.evidence: FastEthernet0/0.10 has an IP address but no ip access-group command was detected in the interface block.
findings.recommendation: Check the intended trust boundary and firewall/routing policy; an interface ACL is not required on every interface.

findings.title: Routed interface has no interface ACL detected
findings.evidence: FastEthernet0/0.20 has an IP address but no ip access-group command was detected in the interface block.
findings.recommendation: Check the intended trust boundary and firewall/routing policy; an interface ACL is not required on every interface.

limitations: Offline static analysis only; no device connection was made.
The tool does not automatically apply remediation commands.
A missing command is not proof of a vulnerability; defaults vary by platform and software version.
Some checks are informational and require validation against topology, device model, IOS version and approved policy.
Risk score is a project heuristic, not a formal CVSS score or compliance certification.
